parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value of this parameter is generated by the client and is unique among different requests. The value is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: CloneDataPoint
parameters.description: The point in time at which data is cloned. Valid values:

parameters.name: CloudProvider
parameters.description: The cloud service provider to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: ClusterNetworkType
parameters.description: The network type of the cluster. Currently, only Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) is supported. Set the value to **VPC**.

parameters.name: CreationCategory
parameters.description: The edition of the cluster. Valid values:

parameters.name: CreationOption
parameters.description: The method used to create the cluster. Valid values:

parameters.name: DBClusterDescription
parameters.description: The cluster name. The cluster name must meet the following requirements:

parameters.name: DBMinorVersion
parameters.description: The minor version of the database engine. Valid values:

parameters.name: DBNodeClass
parameters.description: The node specifications. For details, see the following topics:

parameters.name: DBNodeNum
parameters.description: The number of nodes for Standard Edition and Enterprise Edition. Valid values:

parameters.name: DBType
parameters.description: The database engine type. Valid values:

parameters.name: DBVersion
parameters.description: The database engine version.

parameters.name: DefaultTimeZone
parameters.description: The time zone of the cluster (UTC). The value can be set to any time frame within the range of **-12:00 to +13:00**, such as **00:00**. Default value: **SYSTEM**. The default time zone is the same as the time zone of the region.

parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description: The ENS node ID required when creating an ENS database.

parameters.name: GDNId
parameters.description: The global database network (GDN) ID.

parameters.name: HotStandbyCluster
parameters.description: Specifies whether the hot standby cluster is enabled. Valid values:

parameters.name: LoosePolarLogBin
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the Binlog feature. Valid values:

parameters.name: LooseXEngine
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the X-Engine storage engine. Valid values:

parameters.name: LooseXEngineUseMemoryPct
parameters.description: The percentage of memory allocated to the X-Engine storage engine. Valid values: integers from 10 to 90.

parameters.name: LowerCaseTableNames
parameters.description: Specifies whether table names are case-sensitive. Valid values:

parameters.name: ParameterGroupId
parameters.description: The parameter template ID.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description: The billing method. Valid values:

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: This parameter is required when PayType is set to **Prepaid**. Specifies whether the subscription cluster uses a yearly or monthly billing cycle.

parameters.name: PromotionCode
parameters.description: The coupon code. If not specified, the default coupon is used.

parameters.name: ProvisionedIops
parameters.description: The provisioned read/write IOPS of the ESSD AutoPL cloud disk. Valid values: 0 to min{50,000, 1000 × capacity - baseline performance}.

parameters.name: ProxyClass
parameters.description: The specification of the database proxy for Standard Edition. Valid values:

parameters.name: ProxyType
parameters.description: The database proxy type. Valid values:

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID.

parameters.name: ScaleMax
parameters.description: The maximum scaling limit per node. Valid values: 1 PCU to 32 PCUs.

parameters.name: ScaleMin
parameters.description: The minimum scaling limit per node. Valid values: 1 PCU to 31 PCUs.

parameters.name: ScaleRoNumMax
parameters.description: The maximum number of read-only nodes for scaling. Valid values: 0 to 15.

parameters.name: ScaleRoNumMin
parameters.description: The minimum number of read-only nodes for scaling. Valid values: 0 to 15.

parameters.name: SecurityIPList
parameters.description: The IP whitelist of the PolarDB cluster.

parameters.name: ServerlessType
parameters.description: The serverless type. The value is fixed as **AgileServerless**.

parameters.name: SourceResourceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the source ApsaraDB RDS instance or the source PolarDB cluster. This parameter is required only when **CreationOption** is set to **MigrationFromRDS**, **CloneFromRDS**, **CloneFromPolarDB**, or **RecoverFromRecyclebin**.

parameters.name: SourceUid
parameters.description: The UID of the account that owns the source backup set in cross-account backup restoration scenarios.

parameters.name: StandbyAZ
parameters.description: The zone of the hot standby cluster.

parameters.name: StorageAutoScale
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable automatic storage scaling for the Standard Edition cluster. Valid values:

parameters.name: StorageEncryption
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable cloud disk encryption. Valid values:

parameters.name: StorageEncryptionKey
parameters.description: The key ID of the custom Key Management Service (KMS) key for cloud disk encryption in the same region as the instance. Specifying this parameter automatically enables cloud disk encryption, which cannot be disabled after being enabled. Leave this parameter empty to use the default service key for cloud disk encryption.

parameters.name: StoragePayType
parameters.description: The billing type for storage. Valid values:

parameters.name: StorageSpace
parameters.description: The storage space for the space-based billing (subscription) plan. Unit: GB.

parameters.name: StorageType
parameters.description: The storage type for Enterprise Edition. Valid values:

parameters.name: StorageUpperBound
parameters.description: The upper limit of automatic storage scaling for the Standard Edition cluster. Unit: GB.

parameters.name: StrictConsistency
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable multi-zone strong data consistency for the cluster. Valid values:

parameters.name: TDEStatus
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable Transparent Data Encryption (TDE). Valid values:

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key. To add multiple tags to the cluster at a time, click **Add** to add tag keys.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. To add multiple tags to the cluster at a time, click **Add** to add tag values.

parameters.name: TargetMinorVersion
parameters.description: The target minor engine version.

parameters.name: UsedTime
parameters.description: This parameter is required when PayType is set to **Prepaid**.

parameters.description: The VPC ID.

parameters.description: The vSwitch ID.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID.
